item.text: {"decision":"Remaining keeper-bypass is unresolved, not refuted. D07/D08-supported primary seating loss and the observed carrier release show that the carrier no longer remained retained, but D07 occludes the keeper interface/lateral offset, D10 says centered rigid vertical passage is not possible and no off-center dynamic envelope is available, and D14 does not establish dynamic overlap. Plausible conditional mechanisms are transient offset/rotation, local deformation under load, or an independently bounded off-center dynamic path; existing partial request R_R3InspectionPhotos already covers the needed lateral/rotation/deformation/envelope evidence.","operations":[{"action":"revise","expected_version":2,"replaces":null,"reason":"Specialist reassessment of the assigned keeper-bypass uncertainty using D07/D10/D14. Established premises: D07.S02 and the already-supported hydraulic/motion findings establish 40 +/- 2 mm relative withdrawal, exceeding the D02.S05 30 mm primary seating engagement, and D07.S03 reports the carrier started downward travel at 13:24:03. Challenge to simple centered release: D10.S02 reports 8 +/- 1 mm centered, seated keeper overlap and states simple vertical passage over the yoke is not possible under rigid centered seated geometry. Remaining unresolved premises: D07.S03 says the keeper-to-yoke interface and lateral offset were occluded and cannot distinguish transient offset, rotation, or local deformation; D10.S03 says incident lateral offset and release rotation were not measured and no approved off-center dynamic retention envelope is available; D14.S01 says recovery inspection does not establish dynamic overlap during release; D14.S03 leaves unmeasured deformation/off-center path separate. Therefore the incident condition remains unresolved rather than refuted, because the carrier release occurred but the specific keeper-bypass path lacks measured lateral/rotation/deformation or validated envelope evidence. Existing R_R3InspectionPhotos v4 already covers the immediate evidence need: incident lateral offset, release rotation, validated off-center dynamic retention-envelope evidence, and deformation measurements. A positive answer could support a specific bypass mechanism; a contrary validated envelope showing retention under all bounded incident offsets/loads would challenge this node; unavailable evidence preserves the unresolved status.","record":{"id":"N_R3KeeperBypassUnresolved","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_keeper_bypass_lateral_offset_dynamic_path_event","claim":"During the R3 event, the carrier beam followed a lateral offset and dynamic path that bypassed keeper retention after any loss of primary seating engagement.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D02","D07","D10","D14","D15"],"depends_on":["R_R3InspectionPhotos","R_R3MotionRecord"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}},{"action":"revise","expected_version":2,"replaces":null,"reason":"Specialist reassessment of the joint fall mechanism. Two joint premises are supported elsewhere: D07/D08 support hydraulic support-fluid loss causing about 40 mm relative yoke withdrawal, exceeding D02.S05 primary seating engagement, and D05/D08 support no independent positive yoke block. The remaining joint premise is keeper bypass. D07.S03 confirms release timing but occludes the keeper interface and lateral offset; D10.S02 refutes only simple rigid centered vertical passage, not all off-center/dynamic paths; D10.S03 and D14.S01-S03 leave incident lateral offset, rotation, deformation, and dynamic overlap unmeasured or unanalyzed. Because this edge requires all premises jointly, the full causal mechanism remains unresolved. A validated time-relevant offset/rotation/deformation/envelope showing bypass under the supported withdrawal/no-block conditions could support the edge; a validated envelope showing retention for all bounded incident conditions would challenge it; unavailable dynamic-path evidence leaves the edge unresolved while preserving hydraulic withdrawal and no-block as compatible contributors.","record":{"id":"E_R3HydraulicWithdrawalKeeperBypassToFall","kind":"edge","scope_key":"r3_joint_hydraulic_withdrawal_keeper_bypass_no_block_caused_fall","claim":"Hydraulic support loss with sufficient relative yoke withdrawal, keeper-bypass dynamic path, and absence of positive mechanical restraint jointly caused or allowed the R3 delivery carrier beam fall.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D01","D02","D05","D07","D08","D10","D14","D15"],"depends_on":[],"from_ids":["N_R3HydraulicWithdrawalUnresolved","N_R3KeeperBypassUnresolved","N_R3ActualBlockAbsentUnresolved"],"to_id":"N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall","mode":"all","asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}}],"next_work":[],"upstream_dispositions":[],"disposition":"continue"}
